item.title: Second Half Time
item.description: A quick update of whats going on, wait what really is going on huh. weeks, maybe even months pass without posting anything. Honestly I also don’t know what to say, much/not much has been going on in life, just the same old work-home routine. Well I started reading a book, Atomic Habits, maybe that’s something. My thoughts on the book so far, great opening at each level, i honestly thought the book will be much more heavy on the mind in terms of the words and school of thought but now i can see why its like a fun favourite.

item.title: Catching Up – Long Rollercoster Of Grind
item.description: It’s been a while since I last shared anything here, and honestly, a lot has happened since last time I posted in February. After that point, life picked up pace quickly. I’ve been juggling multiple things—school, projects, and personal growth. This semester has been intense, with Computer Science classes pushing me harder than ever, especially Data Structures & Algorithms and Enterprise Networking. I’ve been trying to stay afloat, learning and unlearning so much in the process.

item.title: Horez's First Blog Note
item.description: I've had this idea of having my own website to document all i do for quite some time now, and this will mark the first step toward that journey. From here on all my significant steps in my it life will all be marked here with as much efficiency and detail as i can. And bit inspiration from NetworkChuck, wouldn't have started this journey now if it wasn't for him starting his.

Since i was little,i have always wanted to do something that involved technology and machinery but doesn’t require you to get dirty maybe from time to time but i still didn’t now what type of field i would belong to.As time went by and i grew up i found out that engineering was that field and so i decided to do my best in what so ever thing i have to do in order to became one but that’s when i was told by someone that they where branches in engineering,branches like aeronautical ,chemical ,civil and computer engineering a few to mention .

The market place is far from where i live ,so if you wan’t to go and by some vegetables you have to a list board about three bus in order for you to by buy your vegetables and board another three for you to get back home.with that ,people are forced to by from the supermarkets and with this depression in Zambia , the prices are quite high and the people are straggling so with that said i would make a big vegetable garden that can supply my community with healthy and cheaper vegetables hence saving the money they would have used on transport in order for them to go to the supermarket or the market place.
and what i believe sir, is that good things come to those who work their asses off. and remember i would never ask you to do anything that i would do myself.

My names are Moses Uzamutuma and i am the sixthy child in a family of seven children in which i have five elder sisters and a younger brother.i am a refuge in Zambia but born in it.my parents are both Rwandans .Due to been a family in a foreign country rising money was not easy .my parents had to go through a lot in order to provide for us as there children.
and what i believe sir, is that good things come to those who work their asses off. and remember i would never ask you to do anything that i would do myself.

item.title: Weekend After Exams Week
item.description: Just finished writing my end of semester exams for year 3 semester 2, this marked the end of my 3rd year and marking the beginning of my final year next time we open. I am looking forward to the final school year, and all the opportunities and learning it will bring with it. My my internship at Probase still going, I official ran and entire semester of school on DL(Distance learning) and I’d say it wast that rough, tho yes the final exams where kinda tough but that’s how all final exams are.
